title.narrative: Floating Solar Project - Indonesia

description.narrative: Demonstrating viability of a large-scale FSPV project at selected sites in Indonesia - to attract investment and facilitate scalability.

Floating Solar PV (FSPV) is envisaged as a potential solutionto address the electricity shortage issue on many islands in Indonesia including the Belitung Island. PT. PLN, and its subsidiaries (PT. BEST-YPK) are actively exploring the potential of renewable energy (RE) solutions, particularly FSPV. However, FSPV installations in Indonesia are limited due to high costs compared to international standards and legal/regulatory constraints imposed on PLN, limiting the purchase price it can offer developers while implementing FSPV projects involves specific considerations. Addressing the inherent challenges of the sector through technical, financial, and policy/regulatory solutions and interventions, will help in creating enabling ecosystem/ modelfor growth and promotion of FSPV project, in Indonesia.
